pagedata.pyBrowseSQL: select pyid as "ClaimID",A.CONTRACTNO as "ContractNo", A.OBJECTNAME as "ObjectName", A.NOMORREKENINGFASILITAS as "NOMORREKENINGFASILITAS", A.NOMORCIFDEBITUR as "NOMORCIFDEBITUR", a.KODEJENISFASILITAS as "KodeJenisFasilitas", a.SUMBERDANA as "SumberDana", to_char((select max(startdate) from pooldata.T_GENERAL g where G.NOPOLIS = B.POLICYNO and rownum=1),'dd/mm/yyyy') as "AwalPolis", to_char((select max(G.ENDDATE) from pooldata.T_GENERAL g where G.NOPOLIS = B.POLICYNO and rownum=1),'dd/mm/yyyy') as "AkhirPolis", a.SUKUBUNGA as "SukuBunga", (select pnc.CURRENCY from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC pnc where pnc.claimid=b.pzinskey and pnc.nopolis=b.policyno) as "KODEVALUTA", to_char((select max(AD.TGLAKSEPTASI) from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_ADJUSTMENT ad where ad.claimid=A.CLAIMID and AD.OBJECTID=A.OBJECTID and AD.CONTRACTNO=A.CONTRACTNO),'dd/mm/yyyy') as "TanggalPembayaran", (select case when cc.CURRENCY='IDR' then cc.CURRENCY else cc.CURRENCY end from POOLDATA.CURRENCY cc where id=(select max(C.CURRENCY) from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_OBJECTCOVERAGE c where C.CLAIMID=A.CLAIMID and C.OBJECTID=A.OBJECTID and C.CONTRACTNO=A.CONTRACTNO)) ||' '|| (select max(C.SUMTSI) from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_OBJECTCOVERAGE c where C.CLAIMID=A.CLAIMID and C.OBJECTID=A.OBJECTID and C.CONTRACTNO=A.CONTRACTNO) as "NilaiMataUangAsal", A.KODEKOLEKTIBILITAS as "KodeKolektibilitas", to_char((select pnc.REGISTERDATE from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC pnc where pnc.claimid=b.pzinskey and pnc.nopolis=b.policyno),'dd/mm/yyyy') as "TanggalMacet", A.KODESEBABMACET as "KodeSebabMacet", (select sum(NILAIAKSEPTASI) from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_ADJUSTMENT ad where ad.claimid=A.CLAIMID and AD.OBJECTID=A.OBJECTID and AD.CONTRACTNO=A.CONTRACTNO) as "TUNGGAKAN", (select max(C.SUMTSI) from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_OBJECTCOVERAGE c where C.CLAIMID=A.CLAIMID and C.OBJECTID=A.OBJECTID and C.CONTRACTNO=A.CONTRACTNO) as "JUMLAHKEWAJIBAN", A.KODEKONDISI as "KodeKondisi", a.KETERANGAN as "Keterangan", to_char((select pnc.REGISTERDATE from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC pnc where pnc.claimid=b.pzinskey and pnc.nopolis=b.policyno),'dd/mm/yyyy') as "TanggalKondisi", '001' as "KodeKantorCabang", case when ((select max(gl.IDPEGA) from pooldata.T_GENERAL gl where GL.NOPOLIS = B.POLICYNO and GL.PRODKE = case when (select pnc.prodke from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC pnc where pnc.claimid=b.pzinskey and pnc.nopolis=b.policyno) is null then (select max(G.prodke) from pooldata.T_GENERAL g where G.NOPOLIS = B.POLICYNO and rownum=1) else (select pnc.prodke from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC pnc where pnc.claimid=b.pzinskey and pnc.nopolis=b.policyno) end)) like '%EDM%' then 'U' else 'C' end as "OperasiData", CUSTOMERTYPE as "CustomerType", OBJECTGENDER as "ObjectGender", DATEOFBIRTH as "DateOfBirth", ASMZIPCODE as "ASMZipCode", ASMADDRESS as "ASMAddress", TELFAXNUMBER as "TelfaxNumber", rownum as "JumlahHariTunggakan" from DATAPEGA.PC_ASM_FW_GCNMFW_WORK b,POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_OBJECTLIST a where B.PZINSKEY=A.CLAIMID {ASIS:DetailTempSlink.NoteKasir}
